# Text-heavy Section

`editorial/text-heavy` &middot; section-level &middot; category: editorial

## Purpose

A long-form text section in a reading-width column: heading, byline and rich body copy.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `html` | richtext |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `byline` | text |  |
| `signoff` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Larger body text in a 480px column.
- **dense**: Standard body size in a wider 540px column. Sets `level: body`, `maxWidth: 540px`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `level` | one of `bodyLarge`, `body`, `bodySmall` | `"bodyLarge"` |
| `maxWidth` | length | `"480px"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored. Paragraph margins can differ slightly. | Fine. Very long emails can be clipped above about 102 KB. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('editorial/text-heavy', {
  "heading": "A letter from the workshop",
  "byline": "Maya Chen, June 2026",
  "html": "<p>Dear friend, summer has finally arrived in Portland, and with it a new crop of linen from our mill in Normandy.</p><p>This season we made three changes you will notice: a slightly longer shirt, a softer collar, and buttons cut from recycled shell.</p><p>Thank you for wearing our clothes for years, and for sending them back when they need a repair.</p>",
  "signoff": "Warmly, Maya and the team"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "editorial/text-heavy",
  "data": {
    "heading": "A letter from the workshop",
    "byline": "Maya Chen, June 2026",
    "html": "<p>Dear friend, summer has finally arrived in Portland, and with it a new crop of linen from our mill in Normandy.</p><p>This season we made three changes you will notice: a slightly longer shirt, a softer collar, and buttons cut from recycled shell.</p><p>Thank you for wearing our clothes for years, and for sending them back when they need a repair.</p>",
    "signoff": "Warmly, Maya and the team"
  }
}
```
